HMS Support library contains base account sign-in UI and HMS service connection components (HuaweiIdSignInOptions, HuaweiApiClient). Sign-in flows are provided by Account Kit — this is a required transitive dependency.
HMS Framework is the base runtime layer initializing HMS service connections. It is a required transitive dependency for all HMS kits; presence indicates the app integrates at least one HMS service.
HMS Common provides shared utilities (HmsApiException, BuildConfig, HmsMobileServiceConnector) used across all HMS kits. Presence indicates HMS Core is integrated; no single feature kit is implied.
Android location APIs → HMS Location Kit. FusedLocationProviderClient, GeofenceService, ActivityIdentification all available as HMS equivalents.
React Native Maps → HMS Map Kit. MapView, markers, polylines, polygons, circles and heatmaps all supported.
RN Fused Location → HMS Location Kit FusedLocationProviderClient.
RenderScript GPU compute → HMS Accelerate Kit provides some GPU acceleration primitives but full RenderScript parity requires NDK Vulkan/OpenCL.
MIME type utilities → HMS Network Kit includes HTTP content type handling.
KeyCharacterMap has no direct HMS equivalent — closest is Wireless Kit for peripheral input device management.
